OAUTH.title: Connect with Akahu
OAUTH.summary: The quickest way. You'll sign in to Akahu, choose which banks to share, and come straight back.
requirements: Your internet banking login for each bank you want to connect

steps.title: Connect with Akahu
steps.body: We'll send you to Akahu, New Zealand's open finance platform. Sign in or create a free account, connect your banks, and approve read-only access for Kiwi Finance.
steps.tip: Kiwi Finance never sees your bank password. You sign in to your bank through Akahu.

steps.title: Choose the accounts to sync
steps.body: Pick which accounts Kiwi Finance should follow. You can add a new account here or link one you've been tracking by hand.

steps.title: Bring in your transactions
steps.body: We'll fetch up to a year of history and sort it into categories. It usually takes less than a minute.
steps.tip: After this we check for new transactions automatically several times a day.

PERSONAL_APP.title: Use your own Akahu personal app
PERSONAL_APP.summary: Free and always available. You create a personal app in Akahu and give Kiwi Finance its two tokens.
requirements: Your internet banking login for each bank you want to connect
A phone for Akahu's two-factor sign-in

steps.title: Create a free Akahu account
steps.body: Akahu is a New Zealand open finance platform that connects securely to your bank. Sign up at my.akahu.nz with your email address.
steps.tip: Personal apps are free for your own use.

steps.title: Connect your banks in Akahu
steps.body: In Akahu, add each bank or KiwiSaver provider you want to see in Kiwi Finance. You'll sign in to your bank through Akahu's secure connection.
steps.tip: Connect every account you use day to day so your spending picture is complete.

steps.title: Find your personal app tokens
steps.body: Open the Developers page in Akahu. Accept the developer terms and turn on two-factor authentication if asked. Your personal app shows two tokens: an App ID Token starting with app_token_ and a User Access Token starting with user_token_.
steps.tip: Treat these tokens like a password. Only paste them into Kiwi Finance, and never share them in an email or message.

steps.title: Paste your tokens into Kiwi Finance
steps.body: Copy both tokens from Akahu and paste them here. We check them with Akahu straight away and store them encrypted.

steps.title: Choose the accounts to sync
steps.body: Pick which accounts Kiwi Finance should follow. You can add a new account here or link one you've been tracking by hand.

steps.title: Bring in your transactions
steps.body: We'll fetch up to a year of history and sort it into categories. It usually takes less than a minute.
steps.tip: Akahu refreshes personal app data from your bank about once a day, and we check for it several times a day.

attention.tokens-rejected: Akahu has stopped accepting your connection. This happens if the tokens were regenerated or access was revoked. Reconnect to keep your transactions up to date.
attention.no-accounts: Akahu didn't share any accounts yet. Connect a bank in Akahu, then sync again.
attention.sync-failed: Your last sync didn't finish. You can try again now, or we'll retry at the next scheduled sync.

security.title: Read-only access
security.body: Kiwi Finance can see balances and transactions. It cannot move money or make payments.

security.title: Your bank password stays with your bank
security.body: You sign in to your bank through Akahu. Kiwi Finance never sees or stores your banking login.

security.title: Encrypted tokens
security.body: Akahu tokens are encrypted before they are stored and are never shown again.

security.title: You're in control
security.body: Disconnect at any time in Settings. You can also revoke access or regenerate tokens in Akahu.

troubleshooting.question: Akahu says my tokens are invalid
troubleshooting.answer: Copy both tokens again from the Developers page in Akahu. Make sure you include the app_token_ and user_token_ prefixes and no spaces. If you regenerated your tokens, the old ones stop working.

troubleshooting.question: An account is missing
troubleshooting.answer: Accounts appear once they are connected in Akahu. Connect the bank in Akahu, then press Sync now and the account will show up to choose.

troubleshooting.question: Today's transactions aren't showing
troubleshooting.answer: Banks share settled transactions, which can take a day or two to appear. Personal apps refresh from your bank about once a day.

troubleshooting.question: I want to stop sharing my data
troubleshooting.answer: Disconnect Akahu in Settings. To withdraw access completely, also revoke Kiwi Finance or regenerate your tokens in Akahu.

supportedBanksNote: Akahu connects to most New Zealand banks and many KiwiSaver and investment providers.
